sentences.en: It is not easy to speak naturally on the radio.
sentences.zh: 在广播里自然地说话并不容易。

sentences.en: Young people naturally react against the attitudes of their parents.
sentences.zh: 年轻人天生会反对父母的态度。

sentences.en: Some fruitarians eat only fruit that fall naturally from plants.
sentences.zh: 有些水果主义者只吃从树上自然掉落的果实。
